CTO's understanding (supporting):
OBJECTIVE: A daily, fully-local operational agent (Content Creator role) that runs every day at 09:00 (the time the owner selected during setup) and produces ready-to-post social content — with NOTHING deployed to the VM; everything runs on this machine in operational mode. WORKFLOW EACH RUN: (1) Search the web to find the most FEATURED products from Egypt on Amazon (e.g. amazon.eg). Return ONLY THREE products — the most featured — each with its price, a description, and its link. (2) From those products, create very impressive, post-ready content that matches proper posters: exactly TWO posts per run — ONE for Facebook and ONE for Instagram — written to match each platform's poster style, under correct/appropriate consent (post-ready copy the owner can publish). FOLDER: use the folder the owner pointed to at project creation — /Users/mostafaadawy/Desktop/AiAgentWorkSpace/Odin-Isolated/_external/Odin Testing/testing — for template files, research files, and the agent's work/output files (research notes, product findings, generated Facebook + Instagram post copy, poster templates). SCHEDULING: fires daily at 09:00 as selected; local scheduler only. SCOPE CORRECTIONS FROM OWNER: remove the earlier Fullstack + DevOps selection — this is NOT a full-stack/deploy project; the operational role is Content Creator (selected from the start). No VM, no deploy, no infra. Everything handled locally and scheduled at the defined 09:00 time. Posting itself is done by the owner (content is generated for manual posting) unless a Meta connector is later added.

APPROVED RECOMMENDED FEATURES:
- Auto-publish to Facebook & Instagram — Right now the owner posts manually; connecting the Meta Graph API would let the agent publish the two posts automatically at 09:00 instead of just drafting them.
- Poster image generation — The request mentions 'matches posters' — generating an actual poster image (not just copy) would make each post publish-ready; needs an image-generation service since none is connected.
- Approval preview step — Optionally hold each day's 2 posts for a quick owner glance/approve before they're treated as final, to keep brand/consent control.
